title: Cost Review
seo: Cloud cost review and savings plan
meta: We find where your cloud spend can come down without hurting speed, with a ranked savings list. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Cloud cost review that finds savings safely
overview: We read your cloud bills and resource list and look for waste: servers that are bigger than needed, idle machines, forgotten test environments, unattached storage, over-priced plans and missing discounts for steady use. You get a ranked list of changes with the estimated monthly saving for each and the risk, and with larger packages we make the safe changes for you.

pkgs.blurb: A bill review with a ranked list of savings.
Savings found and the safe ones applied.
A full review with commitment advice and a monthly cost report.

faq: Will cost cutting slow my app?
We only suggest changes that keep performance, and each one is marked with its risk. Anything that could affect speed, such as a smaller database, is tested first or left for you to decide.
It depends on your set-up, so we do not promise a number. We estimate the saving for each item from your own bill and then show the real change after we apply the safe ones.
Read-only billing and cost views are enough for the review. We do not need payment details, and we never ask for your password. You add us as a limited user and remove us afterwards.
Does this include AI usage costs?
This looks at cloud infrastructure spend. For model and token costs, the AI cost control service on our AI integration page covers that.
